svt_mipi_dsi_configuration Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_configuration:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This class contains DSI Configuration related fields It contains fields variables to configure the MIPI DSI device and setup the verification environment. It has fields for interface type, device type, number of lanes, ecc, crc, eotp generation and reception enable, supported vc id, lane coverage enable, checker enable ulpm and trigger delays.

  function int
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::get_packer_max_bytes_required
 (   ) 

This method returns the maximum packer bytes value required by the suite. This is checked against `SVT_XVM_UC(MAX_PACKER_BYTES) to make sure the specified setting is sufficient for DSI.

The default implementation just returns `SVT_XVM_UC(MAX_PACKER_BYTES) value. Individual suites extend this method to indicate any specific requirements they may have.

 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::eot_processing_enable = 1'b1

Used to enable/disable eot processing.
  • For eot_processing_enable=1, Trailing bytes will be processed by the Protocol layer.
  • For eot_processing_enable=0, D-PHY will process the trailing bytes based on DPHY_T_HS_TRAIL_CLK timing.
  • The default value of this variable is 1'b1.

Member Constraint Documentation

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::pps_parameters_solve_order

Solve order of the PPS Parameters
constraint pps_parameters_solve_order {
    solve dsc_version_minor before native_420_enable, native_422_enable, bits_per_pixel, bits_per_component;
    solve mode_422_enable before picture_width, slice_width;
    solve native_420_enable before picture_width, picture_height, slice_width, slice_height, second_line_bpg_ofs;
    solve native_422_enable before slice_width, picture_width;
    solve bits_per_component before line_buffer_bpc;
    solve picture_width before slice_width;
    solve picture_height before slice_height;
    solve slice_width before num_pkt_per_line;
    num_pkt_per_line inside {[1:(picture_width / slice_width)]};
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::reasonable_dsi_dsc_rc_buf_thresh

Reasonable constraint for rc_buf_thresh
constraint reasonable_dsi_dsc_rc_buf_thresh {
    foreach(rc_buf_thresh[i])
      rc_buf_thresh[i] == buf_threshold[i];
    if(bits_per_pixel == 6){
      rc_buf_thresh[12] == 7936;
      rc_buf_thresh[13] == 8000;
    }
  }

    lp_eotp_recp_enable == lp_eotp_gen_enable;
  }

      (interface_type == PPI) -> eot_processing_enable == 0;

      first_line_bpg_ofs == 12;

    } else if (bits_per_component == 10){
      flatness_max_qp == 16;

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::reasonable_rc_model_size

Reasonable constraint for rc model size
constraint reasonable_rc_model_size {
    rc_model_size == 8192;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::reasonable_rc_offset

Reasonable constraint for rc_offset
constraint reasonable_rc_offset {
    if((bits_per_pixel == 10) || (bits_per_pixel == 14)){
      foreach(offset_values_10bpp_14bpp[i])
        rc_offset[i] == offset_values_10bpp_14bpp[i];
    } else if (bits_per_pixel == 6){
      foreach(offset_values_6bpp[i])
        rc_offset[i] == offset_values_6bpp[i];
    } else if ((bits_per_pixel == 15) || (bits_per_pixel == 20) || (bits_per_pixel == 16 && native_420_enable == 1)){
      foreach(offset_values_15bpp_20bpp_16bpp420[i])
        rc_offset[i] == offset_values_15bpp_20bpp_16bpp420[i];
    } else {
      foreach(offset_values_8bpp_12bpp_16bpp422[i])
        rc_offset[i] == offset_values_8bpp_12bpp_16bpp422[i];
    }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::reasonable_rc_quant_incr_lim0

Reasonable constraint for rc_quant_incr_lim0
constraint reasonable_rc_quant_incr_lim0 {
    if(bits_per_component == 8) {
      rc_quant_incr_lim0 == 11;
    } else if(bits_per_component == 10){
      rc_quant_incr_lim0 == 15;
    } else if(bits_per_component == 12){
      rc_quant_incr_lim0 == 19;
    } else if(bits_per_component == 14){
      rc_quant_incr_lim0 == 23;
    } else {
      rc_quant_incr_lim0 == 27;
    }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::reasonable_supported_vc_id

Reasonable constraint for field supported_vc_id.
constraint reasonable_supported_vc_id {
    (eotp_gen_enable == 1'b1) -> (supported_vc_id[0] == 1'b1);
    (lp_eotp_gen_enable == 1'b1) -> (supported_vc_id[0] == 1'b1);
    supported_vc_id dist {
                          [4'h1:4'h4] := SUPPORTED_VC_ID_1_4_wt,
                          [4'h5:4'h8] := SUPPORTED_VC_ID_5_8_wt,
                          [4'h9:4'hc] := SUPPORTED_VC_ID_9_C_wt,
                          [4'hd:4'hf] := SUPPORTED_VC_ID_D_F_wt
                         };
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::reasonable_video_frame_mode

Reasonable constraint for field video_frame_mode.
constraint reasonable_video_frame_mode {
    video_frame_mode dist {
                           NON_BURST_MODE_WITH_SYNC_PULSE := NBMWSP_wt,
                           NON_BURST_MODE_WITH_SYNC_EVENT := NBMWSE_wt,
                           BURST_MODE := BM_wt
                          };
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::solve_order

Order in which constraints of eotp_gen_enable and ecc_recp_enable should be solved.
constraint solve_order {
    solve eotp_gen_enable before eotp_recp_enable;
    solve lp_eotp_gen_enable before lp_eotp_recp_enable;
       solve ecc_recp_enable before ecc_gen_enable;
   }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::valid_ranges

Valid constraint for DSI Configuration fields.
constraint valid_ranges {
      (mode_422_enable + native_420_enable + native_422_enable + !yuv_enable) == 1;
     dsc_version_minor inside {1, 2};
     supported_vc_id != 0;
         num_lanes inside {[1: 4]};
     num_reverse_lanes inside {[1 : 4]};
         (dsi_protocol_version < DSI2_VERSION_10) -> phy_type == DPHY;
         (phy_type == CPHY) -> (eotp_gen_enable == 0);
    (phy_type == CPHY) -> (eotp_recp_enable == 0);
    (phy_type == CPHY) -> (lp_eotp_gen_enable == 0);
    (phy_type == CPHY) -> (lp_eotp_recp_enable == 0);
    (phy_type == CPHY) -> (eot_processing_enable == 0);
     /**
     * ECC, CRC, and EoTp generation/reception and EOT processing is not valid when driving only
     * payload bytes for generic BFM operation.
     */
    if(protocol_independent_bfm_enable) {
      ecc_gen_enable == 0;
      ecc_recp_enable == 0;
      crc_gen_enable == 0;
      crc_recp_enable == 0;
      eotp_gen_enable == 0;
      eotp_recp_enable == 0;
      lp_eotp_gen_enable == 0;
      lp_eotp_recp_enable == 0;
      eot_processing_enable == 0;
    }
     max_ulpm_delay >= min_ulpm_delay;
    max_trigger_delay >= min_trigger_delay;
     compression_enable == 0;
     if(dsc_version_minor == 1) {
      bits_per_component inside {8, 10, 12};
      line_buffer_bpc inside {[8:13]};
      bits_per_pixel inside {6, 8, 10, 12, 15};
      native_420_enable == 0;
      native_422_enable == 0;
      second_line_bpg_ofs == 0;
      vbr_enable == 0;
    }
    else {
      bits_per_component inside {8, 10, 12, 14, 16};
      line_buffer_bpc inside {0,[8:15]};
      bits_per_pixel inside {6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 15, 16, 20};
      native_420_enable inside {0,1};
      native_422_enable inside {0,1};
      vbr_enable inside {0,1};
    }
     if((native_420_enable == 1) || (native_422_enable == 1))
      vbr_enable == 1;
     slice_height <= picture_height;
    picture_height % slice_height == 0;
     slice_width inside {picture_width, picture_width/2, picture_width/3, picture_width/4};
     (slice_width * slice_height) >= 15000;
     if(compression_enable == 0){
      slice_height == 100;
      slice_width == 150;
      picture_height == 100;
      picture_width == 150;
    }
     line_buffer_bpc == bits_per_component + 1;
     if(mode_422_enable || native_422_enable || native_420_enable) {
      picture_width % 2 == 0;
      slice_width % 2 == 0;
    }
    if(native_420_enable) {
      picture_height % 2 == 0;
    }
    if(native_420_enable || native_422_enable) {
      slice_height % 2 == 0;
    }
   }
